items.title: 61124_Mario Bauza oral history interview
items.q: You know, the Royal Roost become the same time -- and Lester Young playing there too with his group.

ctx.x: This was 1950. So you were playing with Parker in 1948.

'48. That's '50. So we played with Parker in '48. You see, that's what I'm (inaudible). Let me see how the (inaudible). You know, the Royal Roost become the same time -- and Lester Young playing there too with his group. And one of the first guys that played with this band was Dexter Gordon.
